thread:
maria: Quick sync — need finalization on embeddings API behavior for edge inputs before code freeze today. Specifically: unicode sequences (ZWJ/emoji vs surrogate pairs), sentinel/null bytes, empty strings, and whether truncation is per-item or across batch. Any objections to my proposal below? :clock3:

aj: Proposal please — I'm about to land batching changes, want to avoid surprise API changes.

maria: TL;DR: truncation must be per-item, we should treat zero-length items as valid (return zero-length vector? or zeros?), and sentinel bytes (\x00) should be treated as normal bytes unless explicit 'allow_binary' flag set. Backcompat: keep output shape stable and always return 'vectors' parallel to inputs, with nulls for items we couldn't vectorize.

kevin: I'm +1 on per-item truncation. For zero-length items we should return an all-zero vector and a warning in metadata rather than nulls — avoids breaking downstream numpy stack ops. Backcompat: explicitly document shape (N x D array) and type (float32) and keep variant for older clients that expect list-of-lists.

aj: Implementation note: batching code uses continuous tokenization right now; need to change to chunk per item before tokenization to ensure per-item truncation. I'll add a flag 'batch_per_item=true' default true for safety. Breaking change? should be internal-only.

maria: Here's an example request/response we'd expect — please review:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-small",
  "input": ["hello world", "", "👍🏽👍🏽", "a\x00b"]
}

200 OK
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-small",
  "vectors": [[0.012, -0.34, 0.001], [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.023, -0.11, 0.002], [0.001, 0.02, -0.003]],
  "meta": [{}, {"warning":"empty_input - returned zero vector"}, {}, {"note":"embedded sentinel byte"}]
}
```

kevin: Looks good. But avoid '...' in examples in docs — show D=768 and truncated output list length to 3 values to be explicit.

aj: I'll add unit tests: unicode emoji normalization (NFC), ZWJ stays part of tokenization, sentinel byte test, and empty-item zero vector. Also add an integration test verifying response shape is exactly inputs.length x model_dim.

embed-bot: Reminder — update SDK docs for python/js to clarify that embeddings returns float32 arrays; JS SDK will convert to Float32Array on client.

maria: Thanks — can you send a small PR with change to tokenizer + tests? assign to @kevin for review. If no objections I'll merge by EOD. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll review, aim for <2h. :eyes:
